claims.claim: Zegna Summer 2026 campaign was shot on Lake Maggiore with Mads Mikkelsen (palette: pine green, taupe, white).
claims.what_sources_say: The Impression: 'Zegna Unveils Summer 2026 Campaign on Lake Maggiore'. Coverage says the campaign 'is set along the shores of Lake Maggiore' and features 'Global ambassador Mads Mikkelsen'. The zegna.com campaign page for Mikkelsen is titled 'ELEGANCE AT LAKE MAGGIORE'. On the palette, the results say it 'mirrors the natural beauty of the countryside surrounding Lake Maggiore in hues of pine green, rich taupe, and soft, luminous white'. The search summary did not name which of the listed outlets that palette wording came from. Other details in the results: the Zegna family's Riva Aquarama boat and Oasi Lino linen.

claims.claim: Zegna AW25 (Fall 2025) campaign film shows Mads Mikkelsen in Torino stopping for an espresso, plus Alpine scenes.
claims.what_sources_say: Confirmed: the AW25 campaign with Mads Mikkelsen 'was shot inside Teatro Regio di Torino and in the stillness of the Alpine landscape beyond, capturing the essence of Torino with Mikkelsen strolling through its iconic streets, pausing for a slow mid-morning espresso' (theindustry.fashion / The Impression). Not confirmed: the results call it 'the campaign' and never say a film specifically shows the espresso scene. The medium (film or stills) is unconfirmed.

claims.claim: Zegna Spring 2026 campaign "Winter Garden" was set at Oasi Zegna (garden designed with/after Pietro Porcinai).
claims.what_sources_say: The Spring 2026 campaign is titled 'Winter Garden' and 'returns to the Winter Garden at Oasi Zegna'. Also: 'The Winter Garden in Trivero was designed in collaboration with renowned 20th-century landscape architect Pietro Porcinai.' Mads Mikkelsen stars. Note the sources say 'in collaboration with' Porcinai, not 'after' him.

claims.claim: Zegna Mocassin loafer (2025/2026) is presented as designed to be worn without socks.
claims.what_sources_say: 'Its traditional construction allows Mocassin to be worn without socks, celebrating the effortless elegance synonymous with Italian sartorial heritage.' And: 'Designed to be worn without socks, it mirrors the effortless elegance synonymous with the Italian lifestyle.' It is called ZEGNA's 'new signature loafer'. The search results did not give an exact launch year.

claims.claim: Zegna Spring 2026 styling is tonal: camel on camel, olive on khaki, sand on sand.
claims.what_sources_say: The Fashionisto, on the Spring 2026 Winter Garden campaign: 'The tonal dressing for this season operates as a full commitment, with every look moving in the same direction: camel on camel, olive on khaki, sand stacked on sand.' It also describes Mikkelsen 'dressed in suede the color of warm sand'. This is the outlet's own editorial description, not wording from a Zegna press release.

claims.claim: @zegna has about 2 million Instagram followers (2026).
claims.what_sources_say: The search result for the official Instagram profile, 'ZEGNA (@zegna) • Instagram photos and videos', says it has '2M followers and 1,613 posts', with the bio 'Born in Oasi Zegna, leading luxury menswear globally since 1910.' The snapshot date of that indexed result is unknown. One standard search returned a secondary source wrongly suggesting the handle is @zegnaofficial, and it gave no follower count.

claims.claim: Loro Piana Spring/Summer 2026 campaign was photographed by Mario Sorrenti and used colours such as red, yellow, marigold and turquoise.
claims.what_sources_say: Confirmed: LVMH says "Loro Piana unveils the Spring/Summer 2026 Campaign shot by Mario Sorrenti", photographed "in Saint-Paul-de-Vence in the heart of Provence" at La Colombe d'Or and the Fondation Maeght, with creative direction by Atelier Franck Durand. Not confirmed: the colours. The sources describe the palette as "mineral whites, ochres, deep sea greens" and mention only "vibrant hues" in general. A search that named red, yellow, marigold and turquoise found no source using those colours. The colour part is unsupported and conflicts with the published palette.

claims.claim: Loro Piana Holiday 2025 campaign is set in a chalet/library by the fire with muted tones and soft focus "as if lifted from a long-forgotten film reel".
claims.what_sources_say: The Impression: the imagery "unfolds in muted tones and soft focus, as if lifted from a long-forgotten film reel found in a family attic" and "drifts between chalet interiors and winter stillness." The photographer was Annemarieke van Drimmelen. Loro Piana's Holiday 2025 page puts it "in the heart of the Swiss Alps" and mentions "the intimate spaces of the library". The colours are described as "a faded palette of brown, taupe, and green, recalling early evenings by a fire". Caveat: 'by the fire' is how the colours are described, not a confirmed literal setting.

claims.claim: Loro Piana Spring/Summer 2025 campaign was shot at Oscar Niemeyer's Casa das Canoas in Rio de Janeiro.
claims.what_sources_say: The Rake: the collection was "captured against the architectural brilliance of Oscar Niemeyer's Casa das Canoas in Rio de Janeiro". The photographer was Mario Sorrenti, and the models were Angelina Kendall, Anok Yai, Leon Dame, Selena Forrest and Woosang Kim. Luxury Daily headline: "Loro Piana explores Rio de Janeiro in spring/summer 2025 campaign".

claims.claim: Loro Piana Instagram captions are a short headline sentence followed by one to three sentences, without emoji.
claims.what_sources_say: No search result describes how Loro Piana structures its captions or whether it uses emoji. Particl lists some @loropiana post titles that are short headline sentences, such as "In quest for abundance and beauty." (22 Jan 2026), "A journey to the mountains." (1 Dec 2025) and "An elevated vision for high summer." (18 May 2026). The results showed only these headlines, not the full captions, so nothing confirms the one-to-three follow-up sentences or the lack of emoji.

claims.claim: @loropiana has about 3.3 million Instagram followers (HypeAuditor, September 2026) with average likes around 3,700 per post.
claims.what_sources_say: HypeAuditor search results: "Loro Piana has 3.3M followers on Instagram", "average of 3.4K likes per post", an average of 45 comments and a 2.98% engagement rate. One result dates the engagement rate "as of July" with no year. Confirmed: about 3.3M followers. Contradicted: average likes, which HypeAuditor puts at about 3.4K, not 3,700. Unconfirmed: that the data is from September 2026.

claims.claim: Boggi Milano Fall/Winter 2025 campaign is set in wood-panelled rooms with leather sofas and chess boards, and centres on a "community" of men and friendship.
claims.what_sources_say: The Fashionisto: the FW25 campaign 'takes root within paneled rooms and worn leather sofas... men at leisure surrounded by wood, chessboards, and soft light', 'friendship replaces spectacle', 'style, like friendship, is best lived at its own pace.' Quotidiano Motori: the collection is presented as a story interweaving Milan, 'the brand's community' and a versatile wardrobe, showing authentic men in their daily spaces.

claims.claim: Boggi Milano Spring/Summer 2026 campaign "La Vacanza" was shot between Pantelleria and Sardinia in sand, sea and sky tones.
claims.what_sources_say: TheprNET: the SS26 'La Vacanza' campaign features 'a group of friends seeking lightness and discovery on a journey between Pantelleria and the wildest Sardinia', with 'hues that evoke sand, sea, and open skies.' The sources describe the campaign's setting as a journey between the two places and do not use the word 'shot', but that is the plain reading.

claims.claim: Boggi Milano is the official formalwear supplier/outfitter of the FIFA World Cup 2026.
claims.what_sources_say: Several outlets report that Boggi Milano is the 'official formalwear outfitter' and licensee of the FIFA World Cup 2026 and the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. It provides formalwear to the FIFA workforce, including Council members, and sells a World Cup capsule collection. The deal started at the Final Draw in Washington. Modaes calls it 'official supplier of the event'. Boggi also runs a FIFA page on its own site.

claims.claim: @boggimilanoofficial has roughly 170k-250k Instagram followers (2026).
claims.what_sources_say: Socialveins says @boggimilanoofficial has '170.3K followers', which is inside the claimed range. The page has no date, so the figure cannot be confirmed for 2026. The same profile also contains doubtful details (it calls the account a 'digital creator based in Fujian, China'). No official or dated 2026 count was found.

claims.claim: Brunello Cucinelli Fall/Winter 2026 men's collection theme is "Ars imitatur naturam", with a palette of misted browns, cordovan, peat, flint and creamy stone.
claims.what_sources_say: Theme confirmed. Search results say the FW26 men's collection, shown at Casa Cucinelli in Milan, carries the title 'Ars Imitatur Naturam' and draws on Seneca. The specific palette names were not found. Sources describe the colours as 'medium and dark neutrals, enriched with intense, profound hues', 'a deep, resonant palette of forest-floor neutrals and charcoal hues, enriched by the warmth of shearling and suede' (Schön), and 'misty landscapes rendered in shades of stone, moss and charcoal' (Grazia SG / Design Scene). No result mentions cordovan, peat, flint or 'creamy stone'.

claims.claim: Brunello Cucinelli campaigns cast grey-haired model Mark Vanderloo alongside younger models.
claims.what_sources_say: Vanderloo's campaigns are confirmed. The Fashionisto: 'Mark Vanderloo was one of the faces of Brunello Cucinelli's spring-summer 2020 campaign', shot in Morocco by Alistair Taylor-Young. Models.com lists him in the S/S 2025 campaign with Africa Peñalver, Olivia Vinten and Thatcher Thornton. No result mentions his grey hair or describes the casting as an age contrast with younger models.

claims.claim: Brunello Cucinelli Fall/Winter 2026 campaign imagery (Instagram, autumn 2026) shows black volcanic sand beaches, glaciers and lava fields; find where it was shot if reported.
claims.what_sources_say: No result describes black sand beaches, glaciers or lava fields in the FW26 campaign, and no shoot location was found. The results say the Fall 2026 campaign/edit is called 'Pages From Landscapes' and fronted by Francisco Henriques. They say the collection draws on 'misty landscapes rendered in shades of stone, moss and charcoal, with the British countryside sitting at the heart of the collection'. A search for Iceland found nothing linking it to the FW26 campaign. Past Nordic-themed campaigns exist, such as 'Brunello Cucinelli Presents a Nordic Winterland', but they are older seasons.

claims.claim: Brunello Cucinelli Summer 2025 campaign is coastal, in cream, sand and ocean blue.
claims.what_sources_say: The Fashionisto on the high summer 2025 campaign: photographer David Portela and stylist Michela Buratti 'create images steeped in seasonal warmth and coastal clarity'. It also says 'camp-collar shirts, open-weave knits, and crisp tailored shorts appear in shades of cream, sand, and ocean blue', with nautical/maritime references. Models are Francisco Henriques, Louis Baines and Niyo Malik.

claims.claim: @brunellocucinelli_brand has about 1 million Instagram followers (2026).
claims.what_sources_say: The sources conflict, and the most specific dated one is well below 1M. A FashionUnited ranking (April 2026) gives Brunello Cucinelli 587K Instagram followers. Socialveins lists 653.2K, and a Pinterest pin of the profile shows 750K. One search summary said the account had '1M followers', but it gave no attributable source. Favikon gives 1.2M, but that total covers 2 platforms, not Instagram alone. The best-supported figure is roughly 590K-650K, not about 1M.
